title: feat(spec,plugin-audit,cli): the pure core of audit ledger tamper evidence, and the audit-seal secret family
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9DvupjiPmYjrYWP2bSEj6SN)_

Part of #31908

Clause-②: yes (widening) (new exported contracts, a new crypto scope member and three platform objects; nothing main accepts is refused)
Metadata-protocol: none (platform objects and contracts; no authorable key in this slice)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：ADR-0154 第一片（P1a）。加了审计封存的纯计算核心（规范 JSON、行的规范形、加盐承诺、种子派生盐、Merkle 树、签名体），三个新平台对象（检查点、修订、签名密钥），spec 的 `audit_seal` 加密作用域和签名器/投递两个接缝契约，以及 `sys_secret` 引用并集的第 4 族 `audit-seal`。
- 为什么改：后面的封存器和 `os audit verify` 都建在这层上；第 4 族保证 `os secret rewrap` 会重包封存器的种子与私钥，孤儿清扫也不会把它们当成无人引用。
- 风险与回滚：这一片什么都不封存，三个对象也还没注册到任何运行时，运行行为只变两处：引用并集多一族、rewrap 报告多一个 `audit_seal` 计数。回滚就是整体 revert。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-seal/canonical.ts` 与 `signed-body.ts`（核验依赖的每个字节都在这里），然后看 `packages/cli/src/utils/secret-reference-union.ts` 新加的第 4 族。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/plugins/plugin-audit && npx vitest run src/audit-seal`（29 个测试），再跑 `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/utils/secret-reference-union.audit-seal.test.ts`（7 个测试）。
- 需要你做的：无。P1b 到 P4 合入前，cloud 不要给 `sys_ai_audit_log` 加封存 opt-in。

## What changes

**`@objectstack/spec` (contracts only).**
- `CRYPTO_CONTEXT_SCOPES` gains `audit_seal`. The `rotateKey` doc now says that under `audit_seal` the returned handle's `id` MUST equal the input's (ADR-0154 D2), because signed checkpoint bodies name their seed by that id.
- New `contracts/audit-checkpoint.ts`: `IAuditCheckpointSigner` (`sign(bytes) → { keyId, signature }`, `trustedPublicKey(keyId) → string | null`) and `IAuditCheckpointSink` (`deliver(entry)`), with `AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_SIGNER_SERVICE = 'audit.checkpointSigner'` and `AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_SINK_SERVICE = 'audit.checkpointSink'` (D11). `api-surface/contracts.json` and `export-origins/contracts.json` are regenerated.

**`@objectstack/plugin-audit`.**
- `src/audit-seal/` is the pure core. Nothing in it reads or writes storage.
  - `jcs.ts`: RFC 8785 canonical JSON. It refuses every value with no JSON form instead of coercing it.
  - `canonical.ts`: the canonical form of a sealed row (D1).
    - One spelling per instant, whatever the driver hands back. Zoneless SQL text is read as UTC. A `date` column handed back as a `Date` is still `YYYY-MM-DD`.
    - `SHA-256(salt ‖ JCS(v))` commitments of value columns, with absent and null committed alike.
    - Leaf hash `SHA-256(0x00 ‖ JCS(leaf))`, and leaf order `(created_at, id)`.
  - `seed.ts`: the 32-byte checkpoint seed and the salt `HMAC-SHA-256(seed, object ‖ 0x00 ‖ id ‖ 0x00 ‖ column)` (D2). Also the contexts the seed and the signing key's private half are sealed under: scope `audit_seal`, no `tenantId`, key `JCS([tenantIdOrNull, sequence])`, per the seat's Q7 ruling. And `isAuditSealSecretCoordinate`, which recognises those coordinates on a `sys_secret` row alone.
  - `merkle.ts`: the RFC 6962 tree, with an odd last node promoted.
  - `signed-body.ts`: the signed bodies of a checkpoint (D4) and of an amendment (D7, D8).
    - Each body is rebuilt from a stored row through one normalizer, so driver spellings sign and verify the same.
    - The stored row adds `id`, `signature` and a non-null `chain_key` (`org:<id>` or `deployment`) for the unique index. The body keeps ADR-0154's NULL `tenant_id` for the deployment chain.
- Three objects, exported but **not registered** in this slice (registration, translations and the extract config land with the sealer in P1b): `sys_audit_checkpoint`, `sys_audit_amendment`, `sys_audit_signing_key`.
  - All are `isSystem`, `managedBy: 'append-only'`, deployment-level, private by default, and get/list only.
  - The checkpoint carries a `(sealed_object, chain_key, sequence)` global unique index.
  - Keyed text columns are bounded: object names 255, `chain_key` 259 (`org:` plus a `varchar(255)` id), and `row_id` 255.
- `audit-writers.ts`: the excluded-object set gains the three objects. That set literal is the only change in the file.
- **The package root exports four names of the core, and only these:** `AUDIT_SEAL_SECRET_HOLDERS`, `checkpointSeedContext`, `isAuditSealSecretCoordinate` and `signingKeyContext`. They are what the `sys_secret` reference union in `@objectstack/cli` reads. The rest of `src/audit-seal/` is reached by path inside this package (the sealer in P1b imports it that way).
- **No refusal echoes a value.** Every error on the canonical-form and commitment path names the column and the value's type, never the value: value columns carry audit payloads, and an error message gets logged.

**`@objectstack/cli`.**
- The `sys_secret` reference union gains a fourth family, `audit-seal`, which reads the holders the producer lists (`AUDIT_SEAL_SECRET_HOLDERS`).
  - Where both holder objects are registered, every handle arrives with the `(namespace, key)` it was sealed under.
  - Where they are not registered, the family is enumerated and empty when no `sys_secret` row carries an audit-seal coordinate, and a gap when one does. A deployment that never sealed anything therefore keeps a complete union, and a seed whose holder this runtime cannot read is never taken for an orphan.
- `os secret rewrap` maps `audit-seal` to scope `audit_seal`. Its per-scope counts are now built from `CRYPTO_CONTEXT_SCOPES`, so the report counts `audit_seal`.

**Generated artefact outside the packages.** `scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json` is regenerated for the three new out-of-reach objects (`node scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.mjs --write`).

## Outside the claimed file surface

Each of these is named in claim amendment 6762115714:
- `packages/cli/src/utils/sys-secret-orphan-sweep.ts`: its report said "of 3" families. It now reads `SECRET_REFERENCE_FAMILIES.length`, so the fourth family is counted.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/secret/rewrap.ts`: the human-readable render prints the new `audit_seal` count beside the other scopes.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/index.ts`: the four named exports above.
- `scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json`: generated (`node scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.mjs --write`) for the three new objects, which `check:platform-object-tenancy-census` requires. Not hand-edited.

## Deferred to P1b

- **Ruling 3d's pin**, that a sealing pass adds no deployment-chain ledger rows through the sealer's own `sys_secret` writes, needs the sealer, which lands in P1b. This PR pins only that the three new objects are excluded from the audit writer.
- **Translations** of the three objects land with their registration in P1b. This plugin's extract config and its bundle-ownership test own the list of translated objects, and the objects are not registered here.

## Tests

New pins:
- `plugin-audit/src/audit-seal/audit-seal-core.test.ts` (29 tests) covers:
  - JCS ordering, numbers and refusals;
  - one leaf for every driver spelling of a datetime, date and boolean;
  - `sys_audit_log`'s declared column split;
  - commitment, leaf and override shape;
  - salt determinism, plus distinctness per coordinate and across a shifted separator;
  - the seed round-trip and the sealing contexts;
  - coordinate recognition on both sides;
  - Merkle single-leaf, odd promotion, swap and refusal cases;
  - signed-body round-trip from driver spellings, digest movement on every signed field, refusal of impossible bodies, and amendments of both kinds;
  - no refusal on the canonical-form or commitment path carries the value it refused;
  - a deployment-chain checkpoint's signed bytes contain `"tenant_id":null` and no stored-only key (D5).
- `plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.test.ts`: the three objects write no audit or activity row, and a business write fired the same way still does.
- `cli/src/utils/secret-reference-union.audit-seal.test.ts` (7 tests): the family's sides are registered (handles and pairs, the full union, a read failure as a gap) and unregistered (no evidence means enumerated and empty; a seed or a private half in `sys_secret` means a gap and the union refuses; an unreadable `sys_secret` is a gap). The `sys_secret` rows are minted by the real `LocalCryptoProvider` under the producer's own contexts.
- `cli/src/utils/sys-secret-rewrap.test.ts`: `KEEPS THE ROW ID`. A re-seal under a new id is refused and never written, and no write carries an `id`.
- `service-settings/src/local-crypto-provider.test.ts`: `rotateKey` keeps the handle id under every scope, `audit_seal` included.

**Forced test changes** (each one follows from the new family or the new scope member, and nothing else in them changed):
- `cli/src/utils/secret-reference-union.test.ts`: the closed family list now ends `'audit-seal'`, and the two hand-built unions gain an enumerated `'audit-seal'` entry.
- `cli/src/utils/sys-secret-holder-report.test.ts` and `cli/src/utils/sys-secret-orphan-sweep.test.ts`: one hand-built union each gains an enumerated `'audit-seal'` entry.
- `cli/src/utils/sys-secret-rewrap.test.ts`: `SCOPE_OF_HOLDER_FAMILY` gains `'audit-seal': 'audit_seal'`, and one `rewrapByScope` expectation gains `audit_seal: 0`.
- `cli/src/commands/secret/rewrap.guards.test.ts` and `cli/src/commands/secret/rewrap.driver-contract.test.ts`: one `rewrapByScope` expectation each gains `audit_seal: 0`.
- `cli/src/commands/secret/orphans.guards.test.ts`: its hand-built union gains an enumerated `'audit-seal'` entry (a type error otherwise). Because the file is now edited, `check:test-source-alias` judges it, so it also gains the module-top preloads that gate asks for (`@objectstack/runtime`, `rest`, `driver-turso`, `driver-sql`, `plugin-security`, which `schema-migrate.ts` reaches through dynamic imports). No assertion changed.

**Ablations.** Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, turned its pin red, and restored the file to an empty `git diff HEAD`:
1. date before datetime in `canonicalValue`;
2. the second salt separator;
3. the canonical-spelling check in `isAuditSealSecretCoordinate`;
4. the three excluded-object entries;
5. the evidence gap in the family;
6. the registered-holder read;
7. the rewrap id check;
8. `LocalCryptoProvider.rotateKey` keeping the id;
9. a datetime refusal that echoes the value;
10. a NULL organization read back as `deployment`.

## Acceptance notes

- **`row_ids` size.** `row_ids` is a textarea holding a JSON array, as ruled: about 360 KB for a 10,000-row window. ADR-0154 names three objects and no child table.
- **The late-recount blind spot (lands in P1b, named here as ruled).**
  - Each pass, the sealer's late recount groups the last 7 days' rows by `(window, chain)` and compares each count with the sum of that window's checkpoint `leaf_count`. It fetches row ids only where the two differ.
  - One row deleted and one row inserted in the same window leave the count unchanged, so that honest late row is not sealed by a `late` checkpoint.
  - This affects only whether an honest late row gets sealed. It does not affect detection: verify still reports the deleted row `missing` and the inserted one as unsealed.
- **Cloud.** Until P4 lands, cloud should not opt `sys_ai_audit_log` in to sealing: between slices a sealed object would show `modified` or `missing` intermediate states.
- **Out-of-tree providers.** The `rotateKey` id MUST is pinned against the one provider this repository ships. A cloud KMS provider has to honour it too (`carrier: cloud`).

## Verification

- Build: the dependency graph of `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/service-settings` (66 packages) was built under `os-verify-lock`. A later full `turbo run build` was killed by the container's memory limit, and the two connectors it left half-emitted were rebuilt with `--force`.
- Tests:
  - plugin-audit: 82 files, 1299/1299 tests.
  - service-settings: 75 files, 1443/1443 tests.
  - cli `src/utils`, `src/commands/secret` and `src/commands/db`: 149 files, 2336 tests passed and 1 skipped.
- Typecheck: exit 0 for spec, plugin-audit, cli and service-settings. Spec and cli needed `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192` for their test-layer half, which ran out of heap on the default.
- Root eslint: exit 0 for each touched package.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` lists 106 commands for this diff, and every one is run on the final head and reconciled with `--ran`. The fixes along the way:
  - `check-tenant-audit-census` read chained `Hash.update()` calls as unplaceable receivers. Each is now a single `update`.
  - `check:keyed-text-bounds`: three keyed columns are now bounded.
  - `check:platform-object-tenancy-census`, `check:api-surface` and `check:export-origins`: the artefacts are regenerated.
  - `check-issue-citations`: a dangling issue number in a comment was replaced by the gate's name.
  - `check:test-source-alias`: the preloads described above.
